title: LADA Doofers vs Rainucks, Sep 27
notes: Away in LADA's schedule, but the guests on Kirkland's board, with the bench right of center (the home side here); we wore our blue jerseys. LADA's schedule view didn't list the game; its id came from the games against the Rainucks. The video is a recording of LiveBarn's player (3438x1374, scaled up for detection).
The game sheet (SportNinja, read through its public API) gave the score, the scorers, the penalties, the shots and who played; each goal was found on the video and against the arena scoreboard.

Periods from the board's clock: each started when 18:00 began counting (0:31, 20:01 and 39:54 of video) and ended at 0.0 (18:30, 38:02, 66:19), with a 1:00 intermission countdown after the 1st and 2nd. The clock ran through stoppages in the 1st and 2nd and stopped at whistles in the 3rd. The empty-ice proposal found all three periods this time, but its edges were 20-40 s off.

Pfeifer #54, a sub, in goal in a red goalie jersey (#0 Wheeler, #1 Mayorov and #20 Starodubtsev absent). Ten skaters, exactly LADA's planned lines and the game sheet; one of them a sub, Babkin #26. Absent: #4, #11, #12, #16, #25, #27, #38, #44, #61, #69, #76, #97, #98.

Goal 1: the game sheet gives it to Babkin #26 from Komashinsky #13 and Fedotov #71, but Babkin wasn't on the ice (he came on for the faceoff after it); Albantov #29 was at the crease. The page keeps the sheet's credit.

Penalties: Polyanskiy #52's high-sticking at 13:18 of the 1st ran 3:00 on the board (2 minutes on the game sheet) and was killed. Rainucks' #77 hooking early in the 1st also ran 3:00. A timeout in the 3rd stopped play for about 80 s (56:41-58:00 of video).
Shots from the board, matching the game sheet (the shots OCR misread them).
Rainucks' white jerseys with blue numbers passed our jersey test, so many of their crops reached the reviewers, who marked them as noise.

Labeled by hand: no review rows; on/off corrections from a frame-by-frame check of every lineup gap: a track mislabeled #52 at a 1st-period change, #75 and #29 lost by their tracks in the 2nd, the change during goal 5, two staggered changes in the 3rd, and #52 sitting from the timeout to the next stoppage with #75 on in his place.

highlights.note: 1st period, clock 9:12: a scramble at the crease with the goalie down, 1-0. The game sheet credits Babkin #26 (from Komashinsky and Fedotov), but Babkin wasn't on the ice: he came on for the faceoff after it; Albantov #29 was at the crease
1st period, clock 2:43: Rintala #67 takes it to the crease with Pfeifer down, 1-1
1st period, clock 13:18: high-sticking in a battle on the far boards; 3:00 on the board (2 on the game sheet), no goal against
2nd period, clock 16:18: Polyanskiy #52 jams it in at the right post, unassisted, 2-1
2nd period, clock 8:11: a scramble with the goalie down, Komashinsky #13 pokes it in at the left post from Albantov, 3-1
2nd period, clock 6:08: Komashinsky #13 again, jammed in at the left post out of a scramble, 4-1
2nd period, clock 4:27: Spears #23 cuts to the post with Pfeifer sprawling, 4-2
3rd period, clock 17:20: Spears #23 again, out of a scramble at the crease, 4-3
3rd period, clock 6:05: straight off the faceoff in the left circle, Zaychikov #6 from Akulov, 5-3
3rd period, clock 4:11: Sreibers #22 from the left side of the crease with Pfeifer down, 5-4
3rd period, clock 1:49: Akulov #37 drives in from the right and scores at the right post, from Babkin and Polyanskiy #52, 6-4
